scope_note: These are controlled names for repository narrative and the identified historical/procedural contexts. Historical official sources do not by themselves establish a company's present-day status.
rules: Resolve an acronym through this register before expanding it.
Do not translate, paraphrase or invent a legal entity's registered or procedural name.
Use the first_reference form on first narrative mention and the acronym thereafter.
Preserve a different source spelling or entity-form suffix only when it is clearly labelled as a source literal.
Do not merge a company, former name, shareholder, client, payer or represented party without a separate source bridge.
